entries.title: Static Broad-Head Integral-Horn Rhinoceros
entries.description: One newly authored whole stylised rhinoceros-like animal in a fixed four-foot pose. A heavy deep torso rises at the broad shoulders, then flows through a short thick neck into a long massive lowered head. Two unequal thick blunt-tipped nose horns are branches of that same connected body skin, not separate decorative cones or old pig arrays. Four full short column-like legs end in broad shallow three-lobed feet with finite soles. Small side ears, small eyes and a thin short rear tail complete the whole. All body, head, horn and foot boundaries are new. One static animal prop, zero scenes; no exact species, anatomy, horn function, gait, handling or wildlife biological claim.

entries.title: Fixed Splayed Five Finger Plate Gauntlet
entries.description: One complete original static five-finger metal gauntlet display: a single changing-width flared cuff and palm shell retains an explicit open wrist cavity, four separately splayed and gently curved continuous finger forms plus one lateral thumb carry fifteen solid dorsal plate segments and five small knuckle fasteners. Two complete annular cuff borders retain the wrist opening. The under-finger forms are solid display volumes, not claimed to provide wearable finger channels or functioning articulation. This is not the old closed padded boxing fist or a robot arm with two stepped jaws. All geometry newly authored, three opaque constant PBR materials, metres, ground datum and horizontal bounds centred. One model, no wearer or second glove. Nonweapon costume and military-fantasy art only: no hand fit, precise anatomy, working joints, protective or impact performance, manufacturing or safety claim.

entries.title: Fixed Compound Jaw and Long Handle Cutter
entries.description: One newly authored complete fixed compound-jaw long-handle cutter visual prop in a flat open display pose. Two short thick opposed jaw links have a real visible blunt mouth. Two further shoulder link plates and whole closed terminal overgrips complete the articulated-looking assembly. The distinct short jaw links, multiply-pinned cheek frame and independent long levers are newly authored, not old single-pivot combination pliers stretched or shears without handle rings. One prop zero scenes, three opaque materials.
